      NISSANCONNECT®

      Connected and covered

      Welcome to your personalized ecosystem of connected driver experiences. Tap into features like My Car Finder, Remote Vehicle Status, Door Lock/Unlock, and more using the MyNISSAN app. [[1189]][[1666]][[48]]

      Explore NissanConnect®

      Google built-in

      Connect to your Nissan like never before with available Google built-in. Control Google Maps, climate, and more with your voice. Download your favorite apps seamlessly via Google Play. [[1189]][[1643]][[77]][[250]]

      Remote Battery Status

      Use the MyNISSAN app to monitor your EV’s charge status, check your battery level, estimated range, and see how much time remains until a full charge — all from your smartphone. [[1666]][[1734]][[1316]][[48]]

      Wireless Apple CarPlay® and Android Auto™

      Make your Nissan an extension of your compatible iPhone® with wireless Apple CarPlay® integration and your compatible smartphone with Android Auto capability. Use all your favorite apps right from the touch-screen display. [[1189]][[1668]][[250]][[115]]

      Remote Climate Control

      Remotely adjust and schedule your climate via the MyNISSAN app. Precondition the cabin while plugged in, and step inside to perfect comfort without sacrificing range. [[1666]][[1316]][[1734]]

      Wi-Fi Hotspot

      NissanConnect® Wi-Fi Hotspot provides you with the ability to connect up to seven compatible devices to keep you more connected on the go. Stream, browse, share, and more with a fast, powerful connection right from the comfort of your vehicle. [[1189]][[48]]

      NISSAN ENERGY Charge Network

      Set up your NISSAN ENERGY Charge Network account and enjoy safe, secure automatic payments with Plug & Charge. LEAF drivers have access to over 25,000+ Tesla® Superchargers — no adapter required! [[115]][[1731]][[1741]]

      Connected Garage Door Opener with myQ®

      Use NissanConnect® Services to open and close your compatible garage door and even get notifications if it was left open via myQ®. [[1189]][[115]][[143]]

      Walk Away Status

      Leave your Nissan with the confidence of knowing the MyNISSAN app can notify you if you’ve left your windows down or your doors unlocked. [[1666]]

      Remote Vehicle Status

      The MyNISSAN app can remotely monitor key vehicle data like lock/unlock status, estimated range remaining, vehicle health, and more right from your compatible smartphone. [[1666]][[111]][[1734]]

      SiriusXM® with 360L

      Expand your listening options through SiriusXM® with 360L to enjoy a wide variety of ad-free music, plus sports, news, talk, on-demand content, and curated recommendations right in your vehicle. [[1626]]

      TECHNOLOGY

      Technology at your service

      LEAF doesn’t just embrace technology — it owns it. Advanced systems help keep you connected to your ride and the world outside, making every drive smarter, easier, and more intuitive. [[1189]]

      Explore Technology

      Monolith Display

      Over 28 inches of cinematic display puts you in control, allowing you to dial in your digital gauges with convenient steering wheel controls, infotainment, apps, and messaging with your fingertips. [[1189]][[1456]][[143]][[110]]

      Head-Up Display

      Essential info is front and center in LEAF. For more confidence and less distraction, the available Head-Up Display projects key info like turn-by-turn directions, speed, and ProPILOT Assist activity right into your line of sight. [[1490]][[77]][[1735]]

      Bose Personal® Plus Audio System

      LEAF’s available premium audio system from Bose provides a unique and unforgettable audio experience. Feel next-level sound immersion with the built-in front headrest speakers and an adjustable soundstage for customizable, quality acoustics for the whole cabin. [[233]]

      Vehicle-to-Load (1500W)

      LEAF’s Vehicle-to-Load (V2L) tech is ready to power up your adventures with up to three 120-volt AC household power outlets with up to 1,500 watts of output, so you can charge e-bikes, power gaming systems, or run a vacuum — inside or outside through the weather-sealed available external outlet. You can even use LEAF as an emergency power source to keep essential appliances, like refrigerators, up and running in case of a blackout. LEAF isn’t just a car; it’s your personal, portable power bank, ready when you need it. [[1740]]

      2026 NISSAN LEAF

      All-electric, all-new

      A bold new EV for a brave new electric world.

      Frequently Asked Questions

      What type of vehicle is the 2026 Nissan LEAF?

      The 2026 Nissan LEAF is a fully electric subcompact crossover SUV. It’s designed to offer the elevated driving position and versatility of a crossover with the efficiency and quiet performance of an all-electric powertrain. [[1734]]

      How reliable is the 2026 Nissan LEAF?

      The 2026 LEAF builds on more than a decade of proven Nissan EV engineering. Previous generations of the LEAF earned strong marks for low maintenance needs and long-term battery durability, as well as industry recognition winning Wards 10 Best Engines & Propulsion Systems 2025, and Car and Driver's #1 ranking for Best Electric Subcompact SUV. The 2026 model continues that legacy with refined components and simplified electric powertrain design. [[6022]]

      Is the 2026 Nissan LEAF good for commuting or city driving?

      Yes. The 2026 LEAF is an ideal commuter or city driving EV. Its efficient range, instant electric acceleration, and quiet ride help tame the daily back and forth of rush hour. In the city, its compact size and maneuverability make navigating tight streets and traffic a breeze. [[1734]]

      What is the maximum range of the 2026 Nissan LEAF on a single charge?

      The 2026 LEAF offers up to 303 miles of estimated range on the S+ trim. Other trims provide varying range estimates, giving drivers options based on daily commuting or longer travel needs. [[1734]]

      How long does it take to charge the 2026 Nissan LEAF?

      Charging times vary by charger type:

      Level 1 (120V household outlet): Best for overnight or emergency charging

      Level 2 (240V home or public charger): Typically adds significant range in a few hours

      DC Fast Charging: Can add up to 80% charge in minutes instead of hours - ideal for road trips. [[4]][[1731]][[75]]
